title: TikTok view count tracker — oEmbed auto-scrape for gate metrics
description: Auto-fetch view counts for recorded TikTok posts using the public oEmbed API (no auth token needed). Runs daily via PM2 cron, updates manual-posts.jsonl with latest view counts, and sends Telegram alert when gate targets are hit.
source: auto — gate requires 500+ total views but no automated view tracking exists. Operator must manually /updateviews each post.
